text:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only rollout: change_window=2026-03-21T02:00Z–03:00Z. Target: routing policy tweak + limits + batch window. Canary: 2% traffic for 10m. PR: #4789

alex: quick ask — is this a hard pin of model versions or just routing/limits?

sana: routing + limits only. no model swap. per-tenant limit lowered from 120 -> 90 rps, timeout reduced 12000 -> 8000 ms, batching_window 30ms -> 18ms.

michael: noted. main risk = KV cache pressure on long chats when timeout drops. we should enable fallback to previous timeout for tenants >200 active sessions.

jess: can we add an automatic rollback trigger? e.g., if p99 latency on /generate exceeds baseline + 300ms for 3 consecutive minutes, rollback.

ops-runner: +1 on rollback. propose thresholds: p50 and p95 must not regress >10% and p99 < baseline+300ms. also monitor error-rate >0.75% absolute.

deploy-bot: Canary launched at 02:05Z. Canary conf: {"canary_pct":2, "canary_duration_mins":10, "changes":["routing_policy:prefer-local","per_tenant_rps:90","request_timeout_ms:8000","batching_window_ms:18"]}

incident-bot: Observability alert: small spike in downstream retries on eu-west-1-routes at 02:08Z (+0.4%). Investigating.

sana: i'm watching traces. retries originate from tenant-slice:video-encoders. their median seq length is higher — batching_window shrink may be causing extra tail retries.

alex: can we temporarily route that tenant-slice to fallback policy (old routing + timeout) while we evaluate?

ops-runner: running command: `rbac apply-route-override --tenant-slice video-encoders --policy previous --duration 30m`

deploy-bot: Route override applied for tenant-slice video-encoders (expires 02:35Z). Canary still running for others.

michael: good call. continue canary for remaining slices but pause ramp. hold at 2% until next check.

jess: logging for release notes: "Config-only: tightened per-tenant RPS, reduced request timeout to 8s, decreased batching window to 18ms, prefer-local routing policy. Canary applied 2%. Fallback route override applied for video-encoders after retry spike."

deploy-bot: Canary complete at 02:15Z. Metrics summary (non-video slices): success_rate +0.02%, p95 latency -8ms, p99 latency +12ms (within threshold). No error-rate jump.

incident-bot: eu-west-1 retries back to baseline after override. No further alerts.

alex: decision: proceed to slow ramp to 10% after 30m observation. schedule: +2% every 10m with monitoring gates. jess, add to release notes that we pinned video-encoders slice to previous policy and will revisit tuning.

jess: added note and changelog entry. tagging product for awareness.

ops-runner: scheduling ramp job: `deploy-bot ramp --from 2 --to 10 --step 2 --step-interval 600s --gates p95,p99,errors`

deploy-bot: Ramp job scheduled. Will post updates at each step. If gate fails, will pause and notify.

alex: thanks all. keep eyes on dashboards. if we see p99 > baseline+300ms for >3m, initiate rollback plan R-2 (auto revert config to previous state).

michael: i'll watch KV metrics and long-session counts.

sana: will follow-up tomorrow with tuning proposal for video-encoders (maybe increase batching for that slice).

deploy-bot: Thread closed for now. Will post incremental updates during ramp.
